title: Nutty Tender Zanzibari Beef Stew
description: A hearty, nutty-flavored stew with tender beef, aromatic spices, and a silky sauce whisked to perfection, perfect for a comforting Kenyan dinner.

ingredients.name: beef chuck, cut into 2.5 cm cubes

instructions: 1. Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a heavy‑bottom pot over medium heat; sear beef cubes until browned on all sides, then remove and set aside.
2. Add the remaining oil to the pot, sauté diced onion until translucent, about 3 minutes.
3. Stir in minced garlic and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant.
4. Add sliced carrots and cubed potatoes, cooking for 5 minutes to start softening the vegetables.
5. Pour in crushed tomatoes and water, then stir in the beef stock cubes, thyme, bay leaf, cumin, paprika, salt, and pepper.
6. Return the seared beef to the pot, cover, and bring to a gentle boil.
7. Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 45 minutes, or until beef is tender and vegetables are cooked through.
8. Remove the bay leaf, and use a whisk to blend the stew into a smooth, cohesive sauce, adding a touch of creaminess.
9. Stir in toasted pumpkin seeds for a nutty, crunchy finish and adjust seasoning if necessary.
10. Serve hot over steamed rice or with a side of flatbread, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
